head: Pocket Paintbox: watercolor and oil painting app for iPhone and iPad
dek: Pocket Paintbox is a new painting app for iPhone and iPad with watercolor, gouache, oil and ink that you mix in little paint wells like a real paintbox. It costs $4.99 once, with no in-app purchases listed, and was #26 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 24 November.
details: Each paint type lets you change how it spreads, its texture and its sheen, and there are brushes, an eraser and masking fluid. You can paint in layers, bring in a photo to paint from and export pictures as 1200 by 800 PNG files. It's made by Harrison Davies, came out on 27 October and needs iOS 18; version 1.0.2 added a sample painting and better finger painting and zoom.
means: If you'd like to try watercolor or oil painting without buying supplies, this gives you a paintbox in your pocket for a one-time price.
todo: Open the sample painting first to see how the paints mix before starting your own.
